scope: Preview and regression tests only; all eight production source hashes in VERIFICATION.json remain identical.

confirmedBySource: Previous normal flight was 120ms; slow flight was 180ms; fast/short/reduced omitted moving drops. There was no observation-only playback rate.

Previous grid had implicit auto rows with content-dependent sizing; dropMotionGeometry rejects any route whose cell heights differ by more than 0.5px. That rejection left the committed landing visible. The preview ignored the boolean returned by drop.play.
diagnosis.runtimeStatus: No connected CUA browser. Uneven-row suppression is reproduced with deterministic geometry; the original user browser pixels and exact runtime cause were not observed.
diagnosis.productionReview: WAAPI uses a complete ordered path, initial inline transform, shared document start time, and matching flame/box duration. Flame steps off at the 2/3 landing boundary. No CSS transition, JS RAF position update, or playbackRate change drives the production fall. No production frame-jump defect established.

changes: Explicit repeat(8,minmax(0,1fr)) rows and min-height:0 keep empty and occupied cells equal.
Observation rates 1x / 0.25x / 0.1x apply the same drop budget to createBattleAnimator waits and actual dropMotion animations. Production timing constants are unchanged.
Initial / flight 60% / landing snapshots and slider pause and seek actual production WAAPI animations, with a bounded 60-second cleanup.
Visible geometry, start-success, OS motion preference and computed-frame diagnostics; old playback cleanup cannot clear a newer playback.
instructions: Reload the isolated preview. Set battle speed to normal, short/reduced off, observation rate 0.1x, then press Replay: automatic drop.
Use Initial, Middle: flight time 60%, Landing: no flame, or the flight-time slider to hold real animation frames.
Floor/stack/terrain select landing geometry, not speed. OS reduced motion is respected.
protected: No server start/stop/restart, normal play/save access, old_game edits, commit, push or publication.
